test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding the recent appointments and reconstitution of the NITI Aayog is INCORRECT?

options.text: The appointment of Dr. Joram Aniya and Dr. R. Balasubramaniam increases the total number of full-time members in NITI Aayog to seven.
Dr. Joram Aniya holds the distinction of being the first woman from the Nyishi community to earn a PhD.
Dr. R. Balasubramaniam is the founder of the Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement and Grassroots Research and Advocacy Movement.
Former Cabinet secretary Rajiv Gauba was recently appointed as the new vice-chairman of NITI Aayog.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Former Cabinet secretary Rajiv Gauba was recently appointed as the new vice-chairman of NITI Aayog.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Indian government appointed **Joram Aniya** and **R. Balasubramaniam** as full-time members of the **NITI Aayog**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The government appointed **Ashok Kumar Lahiri** as the **vice-chairman** of **NITI Aayog**, while former Cabinet secretary **Rajiv Gauba** was appointed as a **full-time member**. Thus, the statement that Rajiv Gauba is the vice-chairman is incorrect.
 
• The appointment of **Dr. Joram Aniya** and **Dr. R. Balasubramaniam** takes the total number of full-time members in the government think tank to **seven**.
 
• **Dr. Joram Aniya** is an eminent intellectual from **Arunachal Pradesh** and the first woman from the **Nyishi community** to earn a PhD.
 
• **Dr. R. Balasubramaniam** is a qualified physician and the founder of the **Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement (SVYM)** and the **Grassroots Research and Advocacy Movement (GRAAM)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** is the **chairman** of the **NITI Aayog**.
 
• Other full-time members appointed during the recent reconstitution include economist **K V Raju**, AIIMS Director **M Srinivas**, Secretary in the Department of Science and Technology **Abhay Karandikar**, and scientist **Gobardhan Das**.
 
• Dr. Balasubramaniam holds a master’s degree in public administration from the **Harvard Kennedy School, Harvard University**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Dr. Joram Aniya's** inclusion marks a historic moment by bringing an intellectual voice from **Arunachal Pradesh** to the highest level of national policymaking.
